map.检尺径为什么取小头？: Why is the measurement diameter taken at the small end?
map.原木小头端面规整、变异小，国标规定以小头直径为检尺径并按进级规则取值，保证检尺一: The small-end face of a log is regular and varies little, and the national standard specifies the small-end diameter as the measurement diameter with rounding rules applied, which keeps measurement consistent and trade fair.
map.估重公式准吗？: Is the weight estimate formula accurate?
map.估重=材积×气干密度，密度随树种、含水率变化大（0.4~0.9），仅为参考，精确: Estimated weight = volume × air-dry density, and density varies a lot with species and moisture content (0.4-0.9), so it is a reference only; an exact weight must be measured.
